enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow under head. Move left arm. Move right leg. Snore lightly. Wake up briefly. Open eyes. Look at clock. Close eyes. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to left side. Continue sleeping. Wake up at 06:30.
Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry body. Turn off light.
Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Stand up. Put dishes in sink. Turn off light.
Turn on light. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close closet. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Turn off light.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone for time. Board bus. Swipe card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Stand up. Walk to exit. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Put on lab coat. Turn on computer. Open patient schedule. Call next patient. Greet patient. Take patient history. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Prescribe medication. Write notes. Use phone to call pharmacy. Update patient records. Take a break. Drink water. Return to desk. Review test results. Consult with colleague. Wash hands. End shift.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music using phone. Put on headphones. Take off headphones. Stand up. Walk to exit. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock front door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Put dishes in sink.

Walk to living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Put down remote. Get up. Pick up glass. Drink water. Sit down again. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Walk out.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Check email. Type email. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Close browser. Turn off computer. Stand up.

Pick up book. Sit on couch. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put down book. Stretch arms. Yawn. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Drink water. Walk back. Sit down. Pick up book again. Read more.
Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll. Read. Type message. Send message. Watch video. Like video. Put down phone. Turn off light. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to side. Breathe. Sleep.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Sleep.
